mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stock_sync_progress (stock_id, job_type, status, target_start_date, target_end_date, last_synced_date, attempt_count, last_error, started_at, finished_at) VALUES
(#{id}, #{jobType}, 'PENDING', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'PENDING', target_start_date = VALUES(target_start_date), target_end_date = VALUES(target_end_date), last_synced_date = NULL, attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL

INSERT INTO stock_sync_progress (stock_id, job_type, status, target_start_date, target_end_date, last_synced_date, attempt_count, last_error, started_at, finished_at) VALUES
(#{id}, #{jobType}, 'PENDING', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_id = stock_id

INSERT INTO stock_sync_progress (stock_id, job_type, status, target_start_date, target_end_date, last_synced_date, attempt_count, last_error, started_at, finished_at) VALUES
(#{id}, #{jobType}, 'PENDING', #{startDate}, #{endDate}, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'PENDING', target_start_date = COALESCE(DATE_ADD(last_synced_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY), VALUES(target_start_date)), target_end_date = VALUES(target_end_date), attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL
